entities.summary: Sabeer Bhatia is an Indian-American entrepreneur who co-founded the first free web-based email service, Hotmail.com in 1996. In 2021 he co-founded ShowReel with Javed Yunus. ShowReel initially hosted short videos for job seekers and founders. It has since turned into an AI-based entrepreneurship course.
